description: Find the cheapest way to buy a basket of bullion products: best single-dealer basket vs best split across dealers, with shipping and free-shipping threshold hints. Every result carries serve-time freshness stamps: checkedAt, priceAgeSeconds, and priceAgeBasis naming which price the age describes (priceAgeSeconds is null, with the basis explaining the data-as-of stamp, for tools that quote no price).
